A [[Politics/Legends|political]] '''faction''' from [[Beray]] was a party in the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] before [[3000 BBY]], during [[Time of the Rot|the Time of the Rot]]. The [[Slippery Hilts|father]] of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Caretaker]] [[Varner Hilts]] was a member of the faction. Hilts' [[Parent/Legends|father]] worked for [[Standard year/Legends|years]] to acquire the faction [[Unidentified faction leader|leader's]] trust, and planned to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] the Sith. However, before he could carry out his plans, his chosen [[Shikkar|weapon]] fell from his [[Sheath/Legends|sheath]] and lodged in his ankle, earning him the nickname "Slippery Hilts." Slippery Hilts [[Death/Legends|died]] a [[Standard month/Legends|month]] later from an infection in his ankle wound. Soon afterward, Slippery Hilts' [[Varner Hilts' mother|wife]] planned to seduce the faction leader, but she was trapped in a ceremonial urn and left to die.<ref name="Lost Tribe of the Sith: Secrets">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Secrets]]''</ref>
